svg.title: HIPAA-compliant dental AI: Async processing with 65% latency improvement
svg.desc: Orthodontist SaaS: Scan upload → AI analysis → Treatment plan generation using GPT-4 + async task processing
svg.text: Dental AI orthodontist platform: Async + 65% latency reduction

g.text: CBCT 3D scans, X-rays, photos → React/React Native app
AWS S3 with encryption at rest + in-transit • De-identified copies for ML
Task 1: Preprocess CBCT scan • Task 2: Extract dental features
Task 3: Call GPT-4 Vision • Task 4: Generate treatment plan
Reliable delivery • Dead-letter queue for failed analyses • Task retry policy
Results cached for instant retrieval • Audit log: who accessed what scan, when
Compliance: 7-year patient record retention with HIPAA audit trail

svg.text: React.js app displays: AI recommendations ranked by confidence • Doctor approves plan • 65% latency reduction vs sync
